Drive cars, ride bikes, and customize your car in Sheru Bhai's open world.

Explore a big island, drive luxury supercars, fly jets and a helicopter, live in your own gold mansion, change your royal look and grow your fame with your phone's photo app.

Your Royal Mansion

Live in Sheru Bhai's mansion on Royal Hill, with marble floors, gold lion statues, a pool deck and a gold room with a huge pile of gold.

Walk through every room: the master suite, the office, the guest room and more.

• Doors swing open as you walk through, and the main gate slides open when you arrive on foot or by

Make it rain: throw money with the lion money button.

Your Royal Look

• Open the wardrobe in the master bedroom and pick your style.

Suits: White Gold, White Classic and Black Premium.

Specs: gold aviators, black shades or diamond specs.

• On your head: a gold crown, a diamond crown, or a black or white cap.

Supercars, Bikes and Aircraft

15 luxury cars, from supercars and hypercars to a big luxury SUV and a formula racing car.

• Two cars in Sheru Bhai's own designs: a white, black and gold lion hypercar and a diamond-and-gold supercar.

Ride superbikes, and fly fighter jets, a big jet, a propeller plane and a helicopter.

Call any vehicle from your phone and drive anywhere on the island.

Visit the luxury car showroom, where a gold racing car turns on its stand.

An Island to Explore

Roam a big open island: highways and hill roads, an airport, sandy beaches and a beach island, a village, stadium, a police station and more.

Day, night, clouds and rain: let the weather change

by itself, or pick the one you like in Settings.

Your Royal Phone

A gold-and-ivory phone with your own apps:

Live like a king and drive like a legend. Become Sheru Bhai!

description: ### Game Overview"Bam Over it" plunges players into an absurdly challenging physics-based climbing adventure, a delightful and infuriating homage to the infamous genre of difficult games. You are tasked with an incredibly simple, yet profoundly complex, objective: ascend an impossibly tall and bizarre mountain using only your wits and an unconventional tool. Every ascent is a precarious dance with gravity, where one misstep can send you plummeting back to the very beginning, hours of progress vanishing in a cruel instant. This game isn't just about reaching the top; it's about the journey, the existential dread, and the profound self-reflection that comes with repeatedly falling into the abyss. Prepare for a test of patience, precision, and your very sanity, all wrapped in a darkly comedic package that will have you laughing, screaming, and perhaps even crying.### Gameplay and ControlsThe core gameplay loop of "Bam Over it" revolves around meticulously manipulating your character and their chosen implement – a trusty, oversized hammer – to hook onto ledges, propel yourself upwards, and navigate an increasingly outlandish landscape. The controls are deceptively simple: primarily mouse-driven, allowing for precise (or precisely imprecise) movements to swing, push, and pull your way up. Success hinges on mastering the game's finicky yet consistent physics engine. Each swing of your hammer requires careful consideration of momentum, angle, and trajectory. The environment itself is a character, filled with unpredictable objects, slippery surfaces, and gravity-defying contraptions designed to challenge your every move and exploit your slightest error. Prepare for moments of pure genius followed by soul-crushing falls, creating an addictive cycle of triumph and despair.### Features"Bam Over it" offers a minimalist yet deeply engaging experience. Its distinct, somewhat surreal art style complements the game's quirky humor and often frustrating nature. Players will discover a unique sense of accomplishment with every small gain in altitude, transforming minor progress into monumental victories. The game features an understated, often philosophical, narrative voice that adds another layer of parody and introspection to the arduous climb. With no checkpoints, the high stakes ensure every session is an intense, nail-biting affair. "Bam Over it" is designed for those who revel in extreme challenges, offering endless replayability for players determined to conquer its formidable peak and uncover the mysterious secret that lies beyond.
